reviews.text: Everyone was so kind and helpful! They made sure we all felt safe and comfortable during our visit. We appreciated the transparency as well on pricing
Very friendly helpful people here at the hospital
Very caring and friendly staff and doctors to both people and pets.

Portage Park Animal Hospital is a breath of fresh air.  I have been looking for an animal hospital for 6 months and after my first visit with my Selah I knew I found it.  I was very impressed with Dr. Kate Tremlova who made my nervous kitty feel very comfortable.  She took time with us and gave me some good tips  on switching up how I've been treating her Asthma.    I love Portage Park Animal Hospital!

I visited two different days each with a different dog.  I saw two different vets.  Everything on both days was great. Visits were in time.  Both Dr's took their time with the exam and treatment.  Paid bill in the room so I simply had to leave when done.
The employees were great & make you feel welcomed.
Always a great experience! The staff is always terrific!
This is a great vet! The doctors are all so helpful and knowledgeable.
Always a pleasant time at the doctors office for me and the dog?

Everything went wonderfully! A heartfelt thank you to every staff member who gave attention to my cat, Sonia. Special thanks to Dr. Katerinа and her assistant — they were incredibly sweet and caring. Sonia didn't feel stressed at all, and everything went smoothly without any discomfort. I’m sure that next time she won't have any fear of coming back to this clinic. You are the best! ❤️
As always staff members provide exceptional care & attention.  Everyone shows compassion for both human & furry family members.
Dr Robinette was professional and attentive. We appreciate her help with our babies! Patient, attentive, kind and thorough.
Took my dog and cat here yesterday for the first time! All the staff were amazing to us!
My cat, Eugene, had a weird episode at home where he was wailing and fell over. Dr did blood workup and examined Eugene ... Excellent care taken .... These guys are the best!

We had an appointment to update vaccines and everything went great. Everyone was very nice and professional as before. Despite my cat’s anxiety and stress, Dr. Cybulski and the staff handled her gently and was able to calm her down to examine her and also get her nails done. Much appreciated!

The staff is friendly and helpful. I go here once a month for my 1 dog to get a shot she has anxiety with her Addisons disease and they are always friendly and helpful. We usually see Dr. Robinette but all the Doctors have been great. I like that they send text message reminders of your appt. I recommended to my daughter to bring her 2 cats here and she liked them as much as I do.
Everyone is so helpful and caring. They explain in great detail and show true concern for their patients.
Best animal hospital in Portage Park. They have the best Veterinarians.

Finding a vet is so difficult.  I have taken my cat and my dogs to Portage Park, but never took the time to write how awesome they are.  I feel compelled to write this review, because I was so touched by the last time I used this animal hospital.  My dog passed away and we took him here to get cremated.  They took me in right away, they didn’t take advantage of me, and they were so sweet and caring.  After a week or two, I received a paw print and a card signed by the entire staff.  There are no words to say how much it meant to me and my family. Thank you Portage Park Animal Hospital.  This small gesture shows how much they care for your animal and you.  I will never take my animals anywhere else!! Highly recommend.
We love them!
this hospital always goes above and beyond for my cats. Dr. Cybulski is the best and takes such good care of my crew, from emergencies to their yearly exams. thank you guys <3
Nice people very professional thanks
The best Vet in Chicago! I love this place. They are so professional, reasonable (cost), caring, thorough, trustworthy and knowledgeable.

both vet tech and vet were friendly and explained every thing they were doing and instructions for my dogs care were very clear  the facility was very clean  they answered all of my questions and i really loved this place  i highly recommend it
Great pet care. My cat is finicky but loves coming here.

In early August, I took my senior Samoyed to Portage Park Animal Hospital for the first time for a dental consultation with Dr. Cybulski; her approach with Snowball and me was kind and informative. She provided excellent care all around, including dental extraction, cleaning/polishing, and even an unknown fistula. The pricing was reasonable for the services provided, especially since a total of 23 teeth were extracted. Moving forward, Dr. Cybulski will be her primary vet. I will also be taking my second dog to Portage Park Animal Hospital for routine care and neutering.

Efficient
On-time
Nice people
An awesome place to take your pets.   All the doctors and staff are very caring
It's a great place.  Pets are treated great.  And everyone is very professional.

I have been going to Portage Park Animal hospital for a number of years. All my dogs have been here, staff is always friendly and wonderful and the doctors are amazing! Especially Dr. Tremlova! We love everyone at Portage Park!
My fur babies are well cared for by this skillful staff and doctors! We love Dr Tremlova!

Travel 49 miles to go to Portage Park vet. The best in the city and the best in our burb. My 5th pet being treated there. Dr DiChalla is the best. They really care about your pet. When we move to the Elgin area I thought I would try a vet out here. Went once, the care is nothing like you get in Portage. Would travel even further if need be. Love 💕 Portage Park vet and dental clinic. When it comes to care for my dog I don’t question price.

My two babies Lumi and Toffi love Dr. Kate she makes them feel so at ease and comfortable that they actually don’t hate going to the vet! She always helps us with any questions or concerns we have and I’m so happy my babies have such good experience and care over there!
They took great, informed care of my puppy recovering from bite wounds.
Great place! Great staff! They take very very good care of my kitty. Would recommend to all!
The people at the front desk it was very nice
Very professional and transparent…
Very kind staff!
Very nice park. Lot of walking trails, playground for kids, dog park, swimming pool. But it does not have public washroom.
Great clean facility, professional, courteous.  Dr DiCaula is great.   She's very thorough and explains everything.  My pets are in good hands here.
Switched vets for my dog. Portage Park Animal Hospital is amazing! Everyone there is so sweet and caring. They great with my 62 pound pitbull. They are my n ew vet forever. Highly recommend.

I've used 5 vets for various pets in my 50+ years of life and have gone back to Portage Park. They are good caring vets and the cost is better than anything else northwest side local. I definitely recommend them.
Portage Park has treated all of our dogs and we are very happy with their service.

We recently moved to the area so we changed vets for our dog. The team was very kind and helpful. Scheduling and changing appointments was easy and I appreciate the fact that they are open outside of regular office hours so we didn't have to take time off work.
Kind, gentle and expert care. Our pets' guardian angels.

Very professional and affordable. My cat had a dental procedure, and it went swimmingly. All three of my cats have been seen my the doctors. I also really love the techs. They explain procedures thoroughly and put you at ease.

Wonderfully kind, informative and patient staff and doctors. My 17 year old cat is sadly transitioning from this mortal coil and they are helping us out so much. I appreciated the honesty and empathy.

This was not my first experience with Portage Park and I have to say they are still wonderful. Staff was very professional and friendly and Trixie  was handled very gently and her experience wasn't traumatic.
Great facility and wonderful staff
Ive been going here for 10 yrs, friendly and great doctors  and customer service.
Very clean and friendly staff   We were taken care of immediately. I just find their cost to be a bit expensive
Wonderful care
Delightful.

Very good visit. Everyone was friendly and capable.  Vet even reviewed 2 yr old shelter notes before our visit.  Everyone really seemed to enjoy our calm and affectionate cat  They are definitely our vet of choice .
Great experience. The staff was kind, knowledgeable, and attentive. They took excellent care of my pet and made us feel welcome. Highly recommend.
I took my dog in for annual wellness. Dr. Kate and Kelly (tech) were both awesome. They were good with the dog and answered all my questions.

Our fur babies have been patients at PPAH&DC since moving into the neighborhood 4 years ago. We have been to a lot of clinics and animal hospitals over the years. This is the best of them all. Kind and attentive staff. Fair and reasonable prices. They treat our babies just like family! Can’t imagine going anywhere else.
On time , professional, establishment very clean . They treated my dog very gently. Answered all my questions and explained all my options to keep my pet healthy. Very happy with the service.
Staff and doctor are great
Truly the best! Always takes care of my fur baby with patience and explains anything if I have questions.
Dr. Julia was amazing and extremely thorough with Gunner. Gunner is quite reactive to strangers,  she was very calming which allowed for a complete visit including 4 shots!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We took our 15 year old mixed Pitbull to Dr.Tobin. Our old guy still gets set off by rabbits and he went full throttle at two rabbits and pulled a muscle.  Plus he is very arthritic and was placed on the proper meds.  Pepper is taking it easy and recovering nicely. Thank you Dr. Tobin of Portage Park.
Love the customer service and the veterinarian in charge.
Excellent care, treatment and medications explained, appointments available when needed
The state of his loving in pairing explains everything perfectly
Drop off and check in where quick and easy. Surgery wentt well. The cost was within the quote amount. I was explained how the procedure went and how to handle the next 10 days following. All is good.
These folks are always the best have been my vet since 1998. Dr. Kate is just great. And so is all of the staff. They have always been the The most pleasant people to deal with

The staff and doctors are always pleasant, caring, and knowledgeable. Facility is clean and they truly care about your animal and the best options for care. Recently took my cat for a dental cleaning and was very impressed at the level of detail in explaining the procedure and even before and after pictures. They sent him home happy and properly medicated so he’s not in any pain. I would recommend them as the best vet clinic in the portage park, Chicago area.very trustworthy!
We just moved into the area and so happy to have found this place. The facility and staff are excellent and helped answer all of our questions while providing excellent service
Dr. Paige is so kind and helpful. Definitely would recommend bringing your pets to her.
Vets are always good
This is my cat's second appointment and they've been great! I appreciate how low-stress these visits have been.

When I moved to Chicago a few months ago, we knew we wanted to find a vet for our pets that we could stay with for many years. We shopped around for a while, and finally landed on Portage Park. Although it was a 45 minute drive from our house, we’d heard lovely things about the staff and wanted to find a place that really cared. Portage Park turned out to be exactly what we were looking for. First we brought our German shepherd, Kahlo, with whom we’ve had some pretty unpleasant vet experiences (rooted in fear/dislike for the breed) for routine care. The staff was patient, kind, and warm. They explained everything thoroughly and tailored the appointment to his unique personality and preferences. Dr. Cybulski was awesome, and we were very impressed. The second major trial came when our cat, Maya, suddenly started having some strange symptoms. Dr. Robinette assisted her, and was unbelievably kind and patient, helping us figure out what tests to do and going above and beyond to help us weigh options and cost. As grad students, we are committed to caring for our pets but don’t have unlimited budgets, and we really appreciated how closely they worked with us to figure out best next steps. Tragically, a few weeks later, our cat passed on the way to an emergency appointment at Portage Park. It was a horrid surprise that really shook us. I don’t even have words for how compassionate and caring the staff was. Dr. Robinette has called to check in on us in the weeks that followed, and the staff put together a beautiful card and mementos that they gave to us with our cat’s cremated remains. Despite this tragic loss, we are grateful for the care we’ve received at Portage Park for our pets. This is the kind of team you can trust not just for preventive and routine care, but in the toughest of moments. The Portage Park team deserves their flowers, and we highly recommend them.
We were in a rush, so the doctor and helpers accommodated our situation. No problems. It's a great place to care for your pets.
We’ve brought all our pets here for 30+ years. We typically see Dr. Tobin but all the staff is great!
Great group of Doctors and staff! Staff is always so friendly, welcoming and go the extra mile to ensure my pets needs are met. I highly recommend this Animal Hospital!
Walked in without an appointment and was able to be seen right away before closing hours. My pup went home with medication and is doing so much better today!
I am a regular client of this clinic.  The staff is very friendly, the quality and speed of service is excellent.  I am very pleased.
I’ve been coming to Portage Park Animal Hospital for decades and always have a great experience.
Knowledgeable and compassionate vets, we've been going to them for two generations of our dogs, they do a great job
Always great care!! Luv the docs who luv our pets!!!!

Great experience. Would recommend this facility to everyone.
The staff is wonderful with our animals & the Doctors  are outstanding!

My two cats now go to this vet. Eva is super shy and scared of the vet, but they took extra care of her.  I like that they have a large waiting area, so I can sit far away from dogs, which scare my cat. Everyone is very nice and professional. I wish they had a parking lot, but I’m always able to find parking on the street. I’m new to this vet, but so far I am impressed.
I started this review a few months ago. I just went yesterday and I love my cat Eva’s doctor, Dr Tremlova.  I really feel she listens to me and I do NOT feel like they are trying to get me to spend money on extra stuff/tests. It’s a very honest place and I love that it’s close to home. The assistant was awesome and showed me exactly how to trim Eva’s nails so I can do it myself from now on.
I highly recommend this vet- the front desk folks are also very nice and professional.
nice and friendly,  dr D . is amazing....

Since PPAH our two Yorkies began to go to PPAH for their wellness checks we have had nothing but wonder experiences... and they have as well. No bad side effects from the shots they receive, no whining through the ordeal. Simply a good experience that could otherwise be traumatic. We have recommended your services to many of our friends who live in the neighborhood.
Friendly staff!
We've had two of our cats' teeth cleaned here, and it's gone very smoothly each time. No complaints. Prices aren't low, but they're pretty average for a vet these days.

Dr Kate did a great job knowing how our dog gets got shots and all test done
Dr Kate is very compassionate and easy going always thinking of ways she can think of how to handle or dog.Thanks Dr. Kate
Everyone was friendly and helpful.  The wait was minimal and the appointment was very efficiently handled.

The staff worked well with my Bella, and accommodated me the moment I walked in. The staff answered all my questions and concerns and took good care of my Bella...We both left happier and I was reassured that my pet was going to be just fine...

Portage Park Animal Hospital is top notch. Every single person I spoke with seemed to care about my pupper (and me) and genuinely went the extra mile to make me feel better about the situation. I had not made an appointment in a while, and when I called in to check price, I was meet with an offer to reschedule sooner to ease whatever discomfort my pupper was in. Seriously, cannot possibly say enough positive things about this hospital.
Have been her with previous pets over 6 years ago & they still have the best, patient & kind staf.

Absolutely the best animal hospital in Chicago, hands down. The team at Portage Park Animal Hospital delivers impeccable service with true kindness, compassion, and professionalism. From the moment you walk in, you can feel how deeply they care, not just about the animals, but about the families who love them.

Every interaction was thoughtful and attentive, and they went above and beyond to ensure our pet felt safe and cared for. It’s rare to find a place where the staff genuinely treats your loved ones like their own, but that’s exactly what you’ll find here.

If you love your pets and want the very best for them, I recommend Portage Park Animal Hospital. They are simply outstanding!

The staff is fantastic. I would only argue about the business practices set forward by the management and medical director. Lots of pushes for high cost treatment and in-house care, poor pacing for emergency situations that often wittle down to how much money you have in your pocket. There are easily more comforting ways to convince a client, educate and push about plans or systems that could fit in their budget to provide their patient with better quality care of life.

I don't think there is a universal, selfish mentality that animal care should be made up of freebies and discounts. But rather taking more time to discover all options instead of jumping to the most affordable (likely temporary) resolution that may hinder the patient's recovery anyway. It seems like a machine that wants to filter out the lowest bidders sometimes.

Dr. Kate was awesome as well as the staff. Everyone is friendly and compassionate and every area is pristine clean. Dr. Kate is great, knowledgeable and experienced in her field. I adopted Dr. Kate as my new veterinarian, I’m looking forward to introducing my 2 other pups to Dr. Kate, she is a keeper and the very best. I walked away absolutely pleased.
Thank you Dr. Kate and staff for the awesome experience.
Great experience every visit. Dr Tobin and team know my cat so well and treat him & I very good. Very thankful for a dedicated vet
Never disappointed in portage Park animal Hospital. My Layla sees Dr. Tobin. She is amazing. Not one complaint love this place. Girls are so nice in the office as well.

They took great care of my cat when he needed a tooth extracted, and they removed another problem tooth at no extra charge. They really care about their patients and are also very understanding about financial concerns.

My childhood best friend used to bring her dog here. Now I bring my pup, and I'm glad I do! The staff is kind, friendly, and professional. They truly treat you and your dog with the utmost care. They listen, they're thorough, and they take the time to address any concerns and explain results. Their prices are also very reasonable. I trust them to provide care for my dog who means the world to me!

Great and loving staff! They take good care of my dog and he’s not the easiest to deal with and they always do a great job! We love coming here and will continue to come. Thank you to dr. Kate and helper Jessica.

We love Portage and Dr Tobin!
They’re typically very prompt and always super nice!

Rude front desk, and unaffable docs.

Dr. Schwartz points out a single epulis on 1/13/26 during the rabies vaccination. Dr. Wilde administers bordatella/distemper/lepto (2/2/26), and I ask her to check the epulis again to see if I should have them surgically removed. Apparently there are four epulides, not one, which is news to me. Sizable, so it's clear that the other three didn't appear in ~two weeks time. Off to the front desk as instructed to schedule the surgery, and procure my estimate. Rude lady #1 (RL1) rattles off dates, and I select 3/6/26 for the surgery to remove the epulides. However, she tells me I'll need to wait a couple of *weeks* at least for just the estimate. I'm perplexed, so I calmly and rationally pose several queries in an attempt to understand why I need to wait *weeks* for simply the *estimate.* Surgeries are expensive, and as such, planning is quite obviously necessary. Apparently, that didn't sit well with RL1, so now an insouciant attitude commences with alacrity. In the middle of this unpleasant conversation, Dr. Wilde tells her that she charged me twice as much as she should have, and now RL1 has to issue a refund. As my luck would have it, she doesn't know how, so the other two front desk ladies get involved; one to teach her how, and the other to learn herself. Once that's over, I calmly and rationally circle back around to attempting to understand why an *estimate* will take *weeks* because she still hasn't explained the reason to me, and I'm flummoxed. RL2 (the one that didn't know the refund process either) found it necessary to interpose herself into the conversation by telling me with an unbridled supercilious delivery that they put a note in my file to provide the estimate soonest. Ostensibly, it wasn't obvious to the front desk crew that since I wasn't told that that had been done, I'd have no way of knowing from the other side of the desk.

Oh, and it gets better. The refund takes "3-5 business days," which RL1 never mentioned. I had to call back after returning home to figure that out. Extremely perplexing how my payment is debited from my account absolutely instantly, but the refund takes days. Am I earning interest?

After obtaining neither answers, nor my money, RL1/RL2 don't even say "thank you," "have a nice day;" nothing. Complete silence after I've been overcharged, and treated with disrespect for calmly and rationally drilling down on the reason why an estimate takes so long. I STILL haven't the slightest clue as to why. Perhaps there is a valid reason, perhaps not, but there *must* be one. Alas, it's still a mystery.

This is only my 3rd or 4th visit since moving to this neighborhood, and in my personal experiences, there is a palpable negative energy in that place that I experience every single time I go. Every time. Friendly, informative, and competent interactions with clientele appear to be optional based upon my experiences.

I do not recommend this place. At all.
My dog was nervous at his visit.The staff was showed Great Patience!

We had such a great experience at this vet office. The space was spotless, welcoming, and calm from the moment we walked in. Every single staff member was incredibly friendly and kind, which made the visit feel easy and stress free.

Dr Paige was amazing with BonBon. She was gentle, patient, and clearly cared about making BonBon feel comfortable. BonBon absolutely loved her, which says everything. We left feeling confident, supported, and so happy to have found a vet we trust. Highly recommend!
Very nice and loved the vet. Dr. Paige and Sam were great with my dog!

I've taken my cat and dog to Portage for a few years now. The service and kindness is remarkably appreciated.  When my cat had to be put down, they sent a card and were incredibly empathetic and professional.  This week I took my dog because she wasn't pooping and was in pain. I felt heard as I advocated for my beloved dog, and they took the time to answer my questions and let me ramble. I recommend Portage Park Vet to anyone and everyone. They are professional,  clean, empathetic,  and respectful about options of care. I wish I'd taken names, but everyone from the reception to doctor have been nothing but excellent.  When I needed to give medication to my dog and forgot peanut butter, one of the admins gave me some of hers. That's caring!
Caring and thorough. Just charged for a visit.

First vaccines and exam visit for my cat went perfectly! Everything was explained thoroughly, and all service fees were presented when asked, unlike other vet offices! Gentle medical staff and doctor made our visit a breeze(: thank you guys!
Very clean and down to earth staffing, Tx well explained and informed, quick and easy. Thank you.

I came in with my dog after what I presumed was either a stroke or seizure. I was a mess. The vet and techs were increasingly kind and caring. The vet got down on the floor and sat with me while she explained next steps. She made multiple phone calls to other offices in the area looking for a neurologist and explaining my dog’s case.
Even though I have since moved to the suburbs, I continue to make the drive back here for this very reason.

The care received was fine, but they are incredibly sneaky about prices and get curt when you try to work with them about it. We were given a quote that then tripled by the end of our visit. They will try to send you home with medication from in house, but we had to insist on getting prescriptions instead which brought the price down significantly but still not the original price we were told. Vet tech was also seemingly very upset when we were asking for prescriptions instead of being sent home with in house medication which just makes me question the integrity of this practice. Ask for prices at every given opportunity and don't take any of their in-house medications.
Always welcoming. Always kind.
New to this vet and they were so nice! Great experience and glad to have them as our care team
Great Service. Very Knowledgeable and Pleasant Staff. Great Doctor. I am Very Very Pleased having this place take care of my Puppy Sarah a Pure Breed Belgian Malinois
Love this place. Friendly staff and such a great facility. I feel very comfortable with my cats care.
My dogs mommy has been going here due to she has Cancer they are very kind and very attentive towards her and I appreciate rhe care they are giving her Thank you 😢

Had a great visit as always! Pam and the front desk staff greeted Vincent and me promptly and Dr. Robinette and Jacqueline took loving care of Vincent. He impressed Jacqueline with his leaping ability as well! Thanks again for everything!
My favorite place to go for annual check up. My cats love it too. They send me cute remainder cards with my pets portraits, and are very mindful and compassionate, when I had to put to sleep my cat.
I have been taking my pets (cats) here for over 10 years. Doctors and techs are always great.
Dr. Tremlova is fabulous. Clearly loves and enjoys animals. Never feel pressured to spend money on tests, etc. unless really necessary. The whole staff is friendly and helpful.
The receptionists, technician, and vet were all very smart and kind hearted.

My cat Sugarcube was there for dental surgery. I feel that she received excellent care. The procedures were well explained to me. My experiences at Portage Animal hospital have always exceeded my expectations.
My Cat Mira, feel pretty well after the spayed, Love the whole system and I’am 💯 recommend the them to all❤️
I have been coming to Portage Park veterinary for more than 15 years and the staff are the our most conscientious,  careful care for my furry family members.
We've taken our cats to Dr. Tremlova for years and highly recommend both her and PPAH!

My cat can be a little challenging at the vet but everyone was so patient with my Margot! From the moment I walked in everyone was so excited to meet her and they made sure we got everything done that we needed to.
The staff is pleasant and professional.
My cats health issues are always thoroughly addressed and it’s easy to get an appointment.

A great experience as always! My wife and I have gone to Portage Park Animal Hospital with our cats for over twenty years. It is bright, open, colorful, and clean, with free parking right in front.
The veterinarians there are always very professional, knowlegeable, and friendly, and they give very thorough and caring checkups and dental care.
This past time there was to get our cat Flynn ready and certified to fly to Brazil—for his third time. Hospital Manager Lina Meyer is always great at taking care of our paperwork with the USDA, working with our schedule (which was very tight this time), and making sure Flynn is always all set to travel and enter into Brazil with no problems!
So we highly recommend the doctors we have seen there at PPAH—Dr. Tremlova, Dr. Tobin, and Dr. Baedke—and the other staff members who have assisted us.
Here btw is a pic of Flynn and me in Panama City, where we had a short layover.
The staff and vets really care about our furry family member!  They took suck great care of our Gracie,  that we are going to bring all our furry family members to them. Thanks so much.
Fantastic

The staff was super friendly and very informative. My baby Dexter (Yorkie) is always nervous but they were great with keeping him as comfortable as possible.
The cost was reasonable and definitely worth the quality care my baby received.
After many research I choose Portage Park Animal Hospital And Im glad I did. Very professional, great work atmosphere. My fur baby Ted and I do recommend it.
Everything was great. A top notch experience.

I searched for a veterinarian for close to 2 years after our vet retired.  I'm pleased to have my 2 dachshund mix  seen by Dr. Cybulski.  Lovely clinic and very good service.  Definitely worth the wait.  Expensive, yes but worth the service.
Staff very friendly and knowledge.
Great doctors and staff. Always accommodating.
Very nice surroundings.  Office was equipped with everything to make your visit go smoothly.
Professional and knowledgeable. Dr. Gave me options and I appreciate my pets care.
Dr Tobin is exceptional. She feels invested in my puppers’ health. It’s a weight off my shoulders having someone I trust and respect helping me navigate her wellness plan.

I've been taking my pets here for years and love it.  It's a very clean environment. All the staff are attentive, friendly and respectful.  The doctor and the assistant are very thorough, gentle and loving.  Excellent customer service. They also have coffee, tea or water to enjoy while you wait which is only a few minutes.
the doctors are nice the people in there are okay I like it
Caring vets and friendly staff!

I have been coming to this facility with my dog for several years for regular checkups. I also had to have several of her teeth pulled during this time without incident. I recently had to have my dog put to sleep due to cancer. Dr Paige and the staff were very helpful during the process. I was allowed to spend as much time with my dog as necessary in a private room before and after the process. I highly recommend this facility.

My senior dog, Waffles, had the most wonderful experience there today. We have gone there for many years, but as she ages visits to the vet get harder and harder. She’s a big lovable girl with a lot of anxiety. Dr. Robinette(sp)has a heart of gold and a gentle, compassionate soul. And the awesome vet technician who helped us(I’m awful with names but it was lovely and started with an M?)was so great with us. We are blessed and thankful to have you help us care for our beloved Waffle dog.
Doctor Kate is the best. We take all our pets to her.
Great doctors, both my kittens were well cared for by their team!
So happy I chose them for my Bella. First visit went well, I honestly think she wanted to stay. 😺 Staff was amazing and pricing is reasonable. I highly recommend them for veterinary care.

The vet technician was very friendly and fast. The doctor was very knowledgeable and had great bedside manner. I appreciate how they did not try to up charge me on ever diagnostic testing regarding a suspected UTI on my male cat. He’s doing great now after only one day. The facility is beautiful and very clean.
Dr. DiCiaula is fantastic!
This place is great. Everyone is great and their fees are very reasonable. I highly recommend them.

Our surgical tech, Jessica, was an absolute angel. We appreciated all of the support she provided to our family during Simba's surgery. She was so thorough, so absolutely helpful, so empathetic, and just so amazing overall. She gave us great advise and pointers, and had great patience with our pupper and our family, including our toddler, who decided to have a lot of energy at pickup! It's clear that Jessica loves animals and her job and that's the people that you want taking care of your pets! We really couldn't have chosen a better care team.

Dr. Tobin was also very amazing, and we were so happy to learn that she caught an additional, undiscovered tumor prior to the surgery so that we could operate on it as well. She explained the options and recommended treatment in a way that we felt informed and equipped to take the best decision for our pupper. We appreciated the extra care that she took to ensure that she got margins on his mass removals, the incisions were stitched very well and cleanly, and Simba is doing marvelous following the surgery and adhering the care plan that we received from Dr. Tobin and Jessica.

Overall, we were very happy that Simba received - he was in the truly best hands.
Everyone is always very kind and professional.
So helpful, kind, and patient with us pet owners. I always feel safe bringing my babies in.
Dr. Tobin was great, took great care of our little Athena! The rest of the staff is super friendly and compassionate!

The vet and tech were great with my 8 year old pup who has anxiety during her 1st visit with me. Super kind and gentle with her to make the vet as least scary a place at can be for our furry kids.
